creative_brief.thesis: The image is really about fragile openness guarded by ancient vigilance.
creative_brief.abstract_concept: Classical fortress logic applied to network defense
creative_brief.visual_metaphor: A marble watchtower-owl perched on a server bastion, wings spread over a tiny engraved city threaded with glowing cables
creative_brief.image_goal: Tech editorial hero with mythic vigilance, not hacker cliches

art_direction.historical_language: marble owl, bastion stonework, engraved city plan, laurel and shield motifs
art_direction.contemporary_language: server racks, fiber cables, warning beacons, QR-like seals
art_direction.medium: mixed-media editorial collage, engraving plus halftone screen print
art_direction.rendering_language: cross-hatched feathers and stone with halftone cable glow
art_direction.composition_language: A hero-plus-symbolic-object, vigilant bird over guarded city
art_direction.color_strategy: cyan support field with deep ink hero and orange alert accent
art_direction.texture_strategy: engraving lines, stipple feathers, halftone, paper grain, ink breakup

visual_spec.hero_subject: large marble owl with spread engraved wings perched on a server-rack bastion block
supporting_elements: tiny engraved city with glowing cable threads
visual_spec.environment: saturated cyan field with faint classical cornice lines
visual_spec.composition: Pattern A: owl-bastion center at 65% scale, city cradled below wings, diagonal cable lines leading eye, dark margins top and bottom
visual_spec.spatial_relationships: foreground city, midground bastion, apex owl with overlapping wings
visual_spec.perspective: slightly elevated poster view, deep focus
visual_spec.lighting: directional graphic light, ink wing shadows, symbolic orange beacon glow
visual_spec.color_hierarchy: cyan ground, ink-cream hero, orange alert accent

non_negotiables: old x new tension (owl-bastion x servers)

prompt_strategy.reason: FLUX sweet spot 30-80 words, front-loaded subject
prompt_strategy.model_specific_strategy: flux: front-load owl-bastion, HEX bound to objects, no negative prompt

prompts.primary: Engraved editorial collage with screen-print finish: a large marble owl with spread cross-hatched wings perched on a server-rack bastion block sheltering a tiny engraved city threaded with glowing cables below, fragmented firewall portcullis bars and small shield-seals with orange beacons around the base. Saturated cyan background with faint classical cornice lines, centered poster composition with owl-bastion at 65 percent scale and cyan negative bands top and bottom. Deep ink and cream hero rendering with single orange alert accent, fine engraving lines, stippled feathers, halftone, paper grain and ink breakup, directional graphic light with wing shadow masses, antique print through modern screen printing, watchful sophisticated tech-editorial mood, wordless.
prompts.compact: Marble owl guarding server bastion over tiny cable city, cyan engraved collage, ink hero, orange accent.
prompts.model_specific: A marble owl with spread wings guarding a server-rack bastion over a tiny engraved city threaded with glowing cables, engraving and screen-print editorial style, wings in deep ink #0B0C0C on cyan field #18A8C7 with orange beacons #FF8A00, centered poster composition

model_parameters.note: FLUX has no negative prompts; avoid-list folded into prose
